title: The Cartographer of Doubt
subtitle: Short Stories
author: Walusimbi Leon
description: A linked collection of short stories about people who map the uncertain territories of their own lives — a letter never sent, a road not taken, a name half-remembered.
style: Varied literary voices, each story distinct; precise, image-led prose. Endings that resonate rather than resolve.
characters: Recurring towns, a recurring stranger, and a mapmaker who appears in different guises.
setting: An unnamed country; the present and the recent past interleaved.
notes: Write the first story as a self-contained piece about a woman who draws maps of conversations she wishes she'd had. Each chapter a new story.
